GTA 6 comes out this week… and the numbers behind it are insane.
GTA 5 came out in 2013. That's a thirteen-year wait. A baby born that day is now a teenager.
GTA 5 has sold over 230 million copies. Stack them as game cases, and the tower would reach almost 3,000 kilometers into space. That's seven times higher than the Space Station.
The first GTA 6 trailer got over 90 million YouTube views in one day. A world record.
Analysts think it cost more than a billion dollars to make. Rockstar has never confirmed the number.
It's set in Leonida, a fictional version of Florida, with Vice City as its Miami.
And on PlayStation, it unlocks at midnight, country by country. New Zealand gets it first, then midnight rolls around the planet.
Will you play it on day one? Tell me in the comments.
